blocks.text: 92 11305 240TH STREET Cottonwood MR Maple Ridge V2W 0J1

parts.t: Highly desirable end unit at Maple Heights! This West Coast design has an open concept, with 9' ceilings on the main and beautiful oversized windows throughout. Featuring 3 oversized bedrooms and a powder room on the main. The master bedroom has a large ensuite bathroom and a walk-in closet. Bright fenced backyard has a large patio great for entertaining. The complex is well managed, with steps to daycare, transit and walking distance to Alexander Robinson and only a short drive to SRT Meadow Ridge Private School, Kanaka and Albion Elementary schools. Parks/daycare and shopping are all close by.  **Open House on July 29th & 30th from 2-4 PM.**
